breeders.blurb: A small Aptos breeder on Freedom Boulevard raising rare and heritage chickens for temperament, egg color, and breed standard. Current offerings include coop-ready pullets and young chicks, recently Black Star, Welsummer, Opal Legbar, Olive Egger, Wheaten Marans, White Crested Blue Polish, Buff Orpington, and Sapphire Gems, plus fertile hatching eggs. By appointment; chicks from $25.
A Sebastopol hatchery offering chicks and fertile hatching eggs. Check the farm for current breeds, prices, hatch dates, shipping requirements, and pickup options.
Delivers guaranteed-hen pullets, close to laying age, on regular Central Coast routes. A low-fuss option if you would rather skip the brooder stage.
